product_one_liner.value: Verifiable automates healthcare provider credentialing, verification and ongoing monitoring for healthcare provider and payer organizations.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the homepage navigation or footer, and /pricing returns a 404.

named_customers.notes: Both appear on the homepage customer logo wall.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is predominantly product, industry and webinar content; fewer than two qualifying engineer-authored implementation posts were identified.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation includes multiple references, including Introduction, Webhooks and Reports.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Customer Success Manager, Enterprise Customer Success Manager and Solutions Engineer, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Named for code generation, evaluation, testing and workflow assistance associated with its platform and services; this does not establish CredAgent's runtime model.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims annual independent third-party audits of SOC 2 compliance; no audit type is specified.

last_funding.notes: Latest publicly documented round found; announced July 10, 2023.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly documented round was announced July 10, 2023, before the May 9, 2025 window start.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists two customer-success positions and a Solutions Engineer position, but no SDR, BDR or Account Executive position.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest launch announcement found was CredAgent on February 26, 2026, before the May 9, 2026 window start.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Aron Digumarthi's profile dates the start of his Vice President, Customer Success role at Verifiable to March 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A live Customer Success Manager posting requires hands-on Salesforce configuration/integration knowledge, and the API documentation includes a Salesforce integration endpoint; internal CRM deployment is not established.
